_doc: Sales department machine topology (F2, from intent LOCKED 2026-08-06). Workspaces ARE the funnel stages (owner directive: each folder is one part of the loop, carrying its routing, DONE, and floor). v1 lint-only this phase: nodes declare ids + traceability, impls arrive in F3 per the script-vs-LLM triage in procedural-graph.md. done/stage fields feed surface compiler v2.

conditions: lead exists as one row in the cohort ledger with source attribution (icaregrow, podcast_handoff, inbound, website_form, pfs_warm, pfs_cold)
identity deduplicated against every lane before the row lands (one human, one id)
done.receipt: events.jsonl row (opaque subject_id, from_stage null -> received)

not_applicable.S1: identity resolution IS this stage's job — implemented as the intake dedup contract (C10), not a separate guard node in the v1 lint-only graph
not_applicable.S2: no contact targeting: intake only reads arrivals, never selects people to touch
not_applicable.S3: no model calls in intake v1: deterministic parsers over HubSpot/Luma/email/scrape feeds
not_applicable.S8: no cost-incurring nodes: subscription-only scripts under C8 caps

conditions: qualification bar decision recorded WITH evidence: services bar (owner/decision-maker at an ICP-fit optometry practice) OR seller bar (owner signaling exit interest within ~24 months)
the applied bar is named on the record — dual bars never blur

not_applicable.S1: operates on already-deduplicated ledger identities from SG-RECEIVED
not_applicable.S2: scoring only; selects nobody for contact
not_applicable.S3: v1 scoring is deterministic against the locked bars; a model-scored variant re-opens this guard in F3

conditions: two-way exchange within the last 7 days: a human reply or a live conversation (opens and clicks never count)
every draft produced here came from a verified-complete context packet (relationship history: episodes, calls, Circle activity, prior threads)
every draft passed the owner voice check before reaching the approval queue
done.receipt: thread/reply record + context-packet manifest + voice-check receipt

not_applicable.S2: candidate selection obeys the cross-lane suppression sensor in SG-SENSE; this stage only continues conversations it already owns
not_applicable.S4: drafts land in the approval queue; the estate dispatch gateway owns sends (Q12)
not_applicable.S5: drafts only — no dispatch at any autonomy level v1
not_applicable.S6: drafts only — no dispatch at any autonomy level v1
not_applicable.S7: drafts only — no dispatch at any autonomy level v1

conditions: exit happens exactly one way: a revive touch was executed (draft approved + sent via the estate gateway) OR an explicit kill reason is recorded
no row parks silently past its scheduled revive date
done.receipt: touch receipt or kill record with reason

not_applicable.S2: revive candidates are scheduled by park date, not selected by targeting
not_applicable.S3: no model calls: revive drafting happens in SG-CONVERSATION-LIVE under its guards
not_applicable.S4: read-only stage: revive sends run through SG-CONVERSATION-LIVE's queue

conditions: calendar receipt exists with a confirmed time and attendee
the booking is linked to the ledger identity and its source attribution
done.receipt: calendar event id in the booking record

not_applicable.S2: no targeting: bookings arrive from conversations
not_applicable.S3: no model calls: booking detection is a deterministic calendar join

conditions: call attended, decision-maker present, >= 20 minutes (locked at readback)
held receipt carries the qualification bar met and the verified source attribution
the held event is appended to the cohort ledger the same day
done.receipt: held-call receipt (independent of the booking receipt)

not_applicable.S3: no model calls: held verification is a deterministic calendar/notes join; Fathom contributes an intent flag + opaque id only, never content

conditions: all four context-is-king gates ran today: cross-lane double-touch suppression, context-packet completeness, staleness truth on conversation_live, voice-check coverage
floors attainment compared against floors.yaml and every breach became an observation
kill_if and pause_if conditions evaluated with evidence
done.receipt: daily sense observations + run record bound to the run manifest

not_applicable.S3: no model calls: every sensor is deterministic (finite and enumerable = state machine)
not_applicable.S4: watchdog plane: escalations only, via the human outbox

untraced_allowed.runtime/runtime_node.py: F0 scaffold template — replaced by real nodes in F3; kept as the authoring reference
untraced_allowed.runtime/sales_daily.sh: F0 scaffold daily chain — rewired in F3 when runtime nodes exist; timer never enabled before F4 shadow proof
